articles.summary: MONDOVI, Wis., May 4, 2021 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Marten Transport, Ltd. (Nasdaq/GS:MRTN) announced today that its Board of Directors has appointed Tim Kohl as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective today. Tim Kohl will succeed Randy Marten, who has served as the Company’s Chief Executive Officer since 2005. Randy Marten will serve as Executive Chairman…
articles.title: MARTEN TRANSPORT APPOINTS TIM KOHL AS CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND RANDY MARTEN AS EXECUTIVE CHAIRMAN
